what: One video is wrapped onto a sphere of radius 5 (64×64) floating in the center of the panel — with camera z 10 · fov 66 (80 below width 768) the sphere reads as a circle filling about 90% of the panel height, and it rolls .005rad per frame on x and y so the video bends and flows like a kaleidoscope. Dragging rotates it with OrbitControls (distance fixed), and the wheel over the panel scrolls the page. If there is no video child, a 12-second looping placeholder video drawn in the skin color is wrapped on instead

options.step: Per-frame x·y rotation (rad), default .005 — 0 stops it
options.fov · fov-narrow: Camera field of view (deg), default 66 · 80 below 768 width
options.[data-fx-part=video]: (Optional) Get a feel <video> — Play it muted and looping and hide it on the panel. If there is none, a skin-color placeholder video
options.THREE.OrbitControls: (Optional) Load OrbitControls from _vendor/three-addons to drag and rotate

use: <section data-fx="media-sphere-spin" style="height:100dvh"><video data-fx-part="video" src="…" muted loop playsinline></video></section>
note: Rotation is added every frame, not by time (original), so it spins twice as fast on a 120Hz screen. On phones the canvas touch-action is turned back to auto so the page still scrolls when you push the board
